patches.name: Local Premium state
patches.description: Enable device-side Premium state for the authorized vBook 1.2.5, 1.2.6, 1.2.7 and 1.2.9 test builds. Server entitlements are unchanged.

patches.description: Skip the Play installer gate in an authorized local test build. Does not change server integrity checks.
